evidence_plan.requirement: repetitive and time-consuming activities handled by the assistant

payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies the types of repetitive and time-consuming activities that the assistant handles, specifically in the context of Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) systems.

claims.text: The assistant handles repetitive and time-consuming activities such as answering FAQs and processing student questions, allowing workers to focus on more complex tasks.
The assistant reduces the need for tutors to repeatedly request the same information from students, streamlining the interaction process.
